conclusion.next_question: Which checkpoint and recovery phases create the adaptive energy penalty, and can dependency-safe power scheduling remove it without losing the learning, work, or time gains?
conclusion.plain_answer: Adaptive continuation preserved late-stage learning and reached the same useful-work frontier with less attempted work and 40 fewer opportunity ticks at the median. It still failed LC3: measured training-device energy was too high under the frozen energy bound.
conclusion.why_it_failed: The adaptive/fixed device-energy ratio had median 1.068 and a 90% upper bound of 1.134, above the preregistered 1.05 limit.

supported: paired late-stage held-out NLL at equal canonical work
paired attempted work and opportunity ticks across six frozen schedules
local RTX training-only time and sampled device energy
unsupported: real simultaneous multi-site speedup, WAN, or storage performance
measured host, cooling, or facility energy
transfer beyond the frozen model, data, optimizer, and failures

falsifier_labels.all_equal_work_pairs_complete: All six pairs reached identical canonical work
falsifier_labels.attempted_flop_saving_positive: Attempted-FLOP saving interval stayed above zero
falsifier_labels.calibration_no_failure_exact_equivalence: No-failure policy controls were exactly equivalent
falsifier_labels.device_energy_ratio_bounded: Adaptive device energy stayed within 5% of fixed
falsifier_labels.learning_noninferior: Adaptive final NLL stayed inside the 0.01 noninferiority margin
falsifier_labels.opportunity_tick_saving_material: Adaptive saved at least 24 ticks and won all six schedules

interpretation.energy: Adaptive wrote about 2.76 times as many checkpoint bytes and used more local active time, making phase-level power attribution the next causal experiment rather than a scale-up.
interpretation.learning: Adaptive was slightly worse on final NLL in every stratum, but the paired 90% upper bound 0.00850 stayed below the frozen 0.01 margin.
interpretation.work_and_time: Adaptive removed replay/discard overhead: median attempted-work saving was 3.03% and opportunity-tick saving was 40.

assumptions: one LC2 logical tick is treated as one recovery-v2 durable-frontier unit
the recovery-v2 two-failure trace is repeated linearly
adaptive-recovery is a mechanical proxy for adaptive-survivor-continuation
non_comparabilities: recovery-v2 failures are absolute-time events, not the LC2 schedules
modeled energy is constant-coefficient compute plus network energy, not measured device or facility energy
modeled lost FLOP is not observed replayed or discarded LC2 tokens
mechanics_bridge.plain_boundary: Modeled repeated-trace sensitivity conditioned on the observed LC3 equal-canonical-work endpoint. Not measured datacenter performance.
